## Checklist

- [ ] The title and description clearly explain the change and its rationale.
- [ ] The change does not include unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation was updated for changes to commands, setup, output, compatibility, safety, or agent support.
- [ ] User-facing, release-relevant changes were added under `CHANGELOG.md` → `[Unreleased]`.
- [ ] Public CLI output, JSON contracts, package exports, and agent integrations remain compatible, or the breaking change is explicitly documented.
- [ ] No tokens, account IDs, cookies, authorization headers, private paths, raw Codex files, or unredacted environment values are included.
- [ ] Screenshots contain only synthetic or safely redacted data.
